The failure was the test runner, not the feature's code. From a working directory spelled with a lower-case drive letter (`d:\...`, as the harness spells it) Vitest resolves itself under two spellings of the same path, loads itself twice and every file dies before its first test — I reproduced it exactly with `npm test` run from `d:\...` (123 failed, no tests), and confirmed the earlier in-config `process.chdir` (and an explicit `root`) cannot fix it because the double resolution has already happened by then. `npm test` now runs `scripts/run-tests.mjs`, which normalizes the drive letter and spawns Vitest as a child process that only ever sees `D:\...`; argument forwarding keeps narrowed runs working.
